test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, C, F, D, K, O, L, and V are sitting in a straight line, facing south. V sits second to the right of F. Only three people sit to the right of O. K is an immediate neighbour of O and D. Only three people sit between L and V. F is not an immediate neighbour of L.

Who sits to the extreme left of the line?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Only three people sit to the right of O.

2) K is an immediate neighbour of O and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e95a2dc34402649cde69c1f8516591c467b198763b564f7c0d0b52e458bf7c0a.png] 

3) V sits second to the right of F.
